blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The visible tests cover many core cases, but they do not test all behavior required by the instruction, including complete input-record permutation, several stated generated edge cases, exact archive/JSON byte requirements in all cases, and the documented performance requirement.
advice: pinned_dependencies: uv and pytest are version-pinned, but the Dockerfile uses the mutable python:3.13-slim-bookworm base tag rather than a fully pinned image digest.

test_deps_in_image: The Dockerfile runs uvx --from pytest==8.4.1 pytest --version during the image build, placing the test dependency and its cache in the runtime image instead of isolating test installation to the test harness.
